title: "Pipeline 01: MAG Taxonomy Profiling & Master Metrics Consolidation"

output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Load consolidated suite of core data manipulation and Excel packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(janitor)

# Setup paths relative to scripts/01_mag_profiling/ for team portability
DATA_DIR   <- "../../data"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "../../results/tables"

# Ensure output directory exists
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# File inputs
METRICS_INPUT_PATH <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Supplementary_Table 2.xlsx")
GTDB_INPUT_PATH    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Book3-classification.xlsx")

# File outputs
CSV_OUTPUT_PATH   <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Supplementary_Table_2_Updated.csv")
EXCEL_OUTPUT_PATH <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Supplementary_Table_2_Updated.xlsx")
# Load the master metrics sheet, skipping the title row
if (!file.exists(METRICS_INPUT_PATH)) {
  stop(paste("Could not find master metrics sheet at:", METRICS_INPUT_PATH))
}
metrics_df <- read_excel(METRICS_INPUT_PATH, skip = 1)

# Load the GTDB-Tk classification sheet
if (!file.exists(GTDB_INPUT_PATH)) {
  stop(paste("Could not find GTDB-Tk classification sheet at:", GTDB_INPUT_PATH))
}
gtdb_df <- read_excel(GTDB_INPUT_PATH)

# Force the first column of both tables to be named "genome" for seamless merging
colnames(metrics_df)[1] <- "genome"
colnames(gtdb_df)[1]    <- "genome"

# Standardize classification column by position (Column 2)
colnames(gtdb_df)[2]    <- "classification"

# Step A: Perform Left Join with Taxonomy Classification
merged_df <- metrics_df %>%
  left_join(gtdb_df, by = "genome")

# Step B: Impute Functional Counts (Replacing NAs with 0)
# Ensures downstream analysis handles samples with 0 ARGs or Virulence Factors gracefully
processed_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    No_of_ARGs = replace_na(No_of_ARGs, 0),
    No_of_Virulence_factors = replace_na(No_of_Virulence_factors, 0)
  )

# Step C: Simplify Genome/Bin ID Strings
# Strip complex contextual prefixes to keep genome identifiers clean and legible
final_supp_table <- processed_df %>%
  mutate(genome = genome %>%
    str_remove_all("(?i)^(SocPer_Social_|SeasPer_Seasonal_|SocCo_)")
  )

# Targeted sanity check for the deep multi-drug resistant outlier (Viyela bin.11)
print("--- Verifying Outlier MAG Presence & Metrics ---")
verification_check <- final_supp_table %>% 
  filter(str_detect(genome, "EA-b002-VIY-55519-23-May-2014_bin.11"))

print(verification_check)

# Save as CSV for flat-file workflows
write_csv(final_supp_table, CSV_OUTPUT_PATH)
print(paste("Flat-file summary successfully saved to:", CSV_OUTPUT_PATH))

# Save as Excel Spreadsheet for supplementary material integration
write_xlsx(final_supp_table, EXCEL_OUTPUT_PATH)
print(paste("Excel publication table successfully saved to:", EXCEL_OUTPUT_PATH))
